item.title: 8 takeaways from the Texas, North Carolina, Arkansas primaries
item.description: WASHINGTON — And we’re off. Voters in Texas, Arkansas and North Carolina went to the polls on Tuesday, officially kicking off the 2026 midterm elections. Some votes are still being counted and a handful of races are moving to a runoff, but there are a handful of important lessons and takeaways.

item.title: White House says Trump using preventative skin treatment for neck rash, offers no other details
item.description: President Donald Trump is using a preventative treatment for a red rash on his neck, according to his physician, but the White House declined on Wednesday to share further details about the condition.

item.title: Tech giants sign energy pledge at White House ahead of midterms
item.description: Google, Microsoft , Meta, Amazon and several artificial intelligence companies signed a pledge at the White House on Wednesday to bear the cost of new electricity generation to power their data centers.

item.title: ‘We both help each other in different ways’: Bailey twins win wrestling state titles
item.description: Big Island sister twins dominated on the mat during last weekend’s Texaco Wrestling State Championships on Oahu.

item.title: Patriots releasing Stefon Diggs after start of league year
item.description: BOSTON — The Patriots plan to release wide receiver Stefon Diggs after the start of the league year, a source confirmed to the Boston Herald.

item.title: Johnson felt like a fish out of water until he arrived at UH
item.description: These days, things are going swimmingly for University of Hawaii basketball center Isaac “Big Fish” Johnson.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo is playing? 3 reasons the Bucks’ star is back on the court
item.description: While it didn’t end up helping the Milwaukee Bucks against the Boston Celtics on Monday, star forward Giannis Antetokounmpo returned to action after being sidelined with a right calf strain for more than five weeks.

item.title: Council bill targets some ‘luxury’ homes in Hawaii County
item.description: The Hawaii County Council voted 5-1 on Wednesday to pass a measure creating a new residential property tax classification for luxury homes worth more than $4 million.

item.title: Immigration-related bills clear a state House committee
item.description: The state House Judiciary and Hawaiian Affairs Committee has approved, ahead of a crucial deadline, a raft of immigration-related bills seeking to limit state law enforcers’ collaboration with federal authorities in immigration enforcement.

item.title: GLP-1 drugs protect against new or worsening addictions, large study shows
item.description: Ozempic, Mounjaro and other GLP-1 drugs for diabetes can prevent the formation of new substance use disorders and alleviate existing addictions, according to findings from a large study of U.S. military veterans.
